The '''Trax Tube''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that crossed the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]], which was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Deysum III]] was located on this run.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Redda Macrebe]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] "procurement specialist," preyed upon Imperial ships along this route. He was aided by [[Tisilan|Mister Tisilan]], an art [[Thief/Legends|thief]], and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Vo Lantes]].<ref name="AJ7">{{JournalCite|7|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref>
